timeline.summary: On April 22, 2026, Reliance Industries reported that its subsidiary Jiostar India's wholly-owned subsidiary IndiaCast Media Distribution amalgamated into Jiostar India effective April 21, 2026.
On April 24, 2026, Reliance Industries announced a partnership with TIME to bring the TIME100 Next franchise to India for the first time, culminating in a gala in Mumbai in December 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹298,621 Cr (+12.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹16,971 Cr (-12.6% YoY).
Reliance Retail acquired Priyanka Chopra Jonas's Anomaly beauty brand on April 30, 2026

On May 7, 2026, Reliance Industries announced termination of its previously approved acquisition of 100% equity stake in Kandla GHA Transmission Limited from PFC Consulting Limited after PFC annulled the bidding process.
Reliance Industries Limited scheduled its 49th Annual General Meeting (Post-IPO) for June 19, 2026, at 2:00 PM (IST) via video conferencing.
On May 29, 2026, Moody's upgraded Reliance Industries' senior unsecured US$ fixed rate notes from Baa2 to Baa1 with a stable outlook.

On 29 May 2026, the Supreme Court held that fraud under PFUTP Regulations was not made out against Reliance Industries in the RPL scrip matter, set aside SAT's fraud finding, and upheld only the ₹25 Cr penalty for violating 2001 position-limit disclosure circulars.
On October 14, 2026, Reliance Industries announced that Jio Platforms filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an IPO opening on October 21, 2026.
On October 21, 2026, ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]AAA (Stable) on Reliance Industries' NCDs and assigned [ICRA]AAA (Stable) to ₹50,000 Cr bank loan facilities.
Reliance Industries finalized Jio Platforms IPO at ₹1,119 per share on October 24, 2026
